# Private candidate-data rule

The active Google Drive workspace owns private candidate information. Read `data/about.md` there before producing candidate-specific output. Do not commit it to this repository.

The generic template at `templates/candidate-data/about.md` is only for initializing a different private workspace. Use supported facts only; never fabricate experience, contact details, compensation, or submission status.
